turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Khan from Hyderabad?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Deepak Sharma from the RBI digital compliance cell. I am calling regarding your savings account KYC which has expired today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Expired? But I gave my papers to the branch last year.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, there is a new government mandate and your file is incomplete. If we do not update it now, your account will be blocked by evening.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh my god, please tell me what to do. I have some payments pending.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry, I can fix this for you right now. I just need to verify your identity first.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, what do you need from me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please tell me your sixteen digit debit card number and the Aadhaar number linked to the account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is this safe? My son told me not to give these things over the phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am an officer from the RBI, madam. To prove it, I will send a verification link for twelve thousand rupees which will be refunded instantly after the KYC is done.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand? That is a lot of money, why is it needed for KYC?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is just a security deposit for the activation. Now please give me the OTP you just received on your phone to complete the process.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, let me check the message first.
